power_observations.notes: Data Center Dynamics reported 9.4 MW for the operating JKT2 building on July 26, 2025. NTT’s Jakarta brochure identifies this as client IT load in that building.
NTT reported an annex design with 12 MW of planned critical IT load in May 2024. The operator expected completion in early 2026.
The applicant estimates approximately 600 MW of IT load for the proposed campus at full build-out.
Digital Realty reported 1.5 MW of operating IT capacity at KUL10, formerly TelcoHub 1, when it launched its Malaysia operations on June 8, 2026.
iXAfrica reported 2.25 MW of live IT capacity for the initial deployment at Nairobi NBOX1.
Rated IT capacity of NBOX1’s first building, NBOX1.1. The operator’s PTC presentation identifies the 4.5 MW first-building rating as IT power.
iXAfrica and RMB confirmed 2.25 MW of first-phase IT capacity in service at Nairobi One on September 4, 2025.
Full-build IT design for the Nairobi One campus, including its first building. The operator’s PTC presentation identifies this design rating as IT power.

status.summary: Hurricane Electric confirms current commercial service at iXAfrica’s Nairobi NBOX1 campus on November 25.
